verdict.rationale: Shortwave is an email client with team collaboration features, so asking whether its inbox also handles SMS, WhatsApp, social or live chat is a fair question. The evidence shows only Gmail-based email: the founder describes integrating with Gmail's APIs. Its AI integrations with Slack, Zapier and MCP let the assistant act in other apps, but they do not bring other customer channels into the inbox, so there is no evidence of multichannel conversations.
